name: Strategy
summary: In a world that demands new and better, no one can afford to stand still. Your brand can be a catalyst for change, helping you supercharge your transformation efforts and drive business performance.
metaDescription: Strategy from Narris International: research-informed positioning and stakeholder alignment for leaders and institutions.
lead: We dig through data and do the blue sky thinking to help organizations build brands that drive success.

deliverables.name: Analysis
deliverables.text: We review your business, competitive landscape, cultural context, and changing customer needs to add clarity and direction to business strategy and guide brand decisions.

deliverables.name: Positioning
deliverables.text: We uncover the simple idea that expresses your unique value and turn it into a philosophy that governs your brand's decisions and actions.

deliverables.name: Brand architecture
deliverables.text: We develop the structure that supports your story, aligning brand expression with business strategy and giving you a roadmap for growth.

deliverables.name: Envisioning/Innovation
deliverables.text: We facilitate innovation through the lens of brand, helping you imagine and create new things that deliver on your new strategy.

name: Design
summary: Narris fuses emotion, art and rigor to turn your vision of tomorrow into something your customers can feel today.
metaDescription: Design from Narris International: narrative architecture, publication structure and positioning documents that make complex ideas clear.
lead: We bring together emotion, art and rigor to design brand experiences that surprise, delight and drive measurable results.

deliverables.name: Brand design audits
deliverables.text: We analyze opportunities for communicating with your customers at every stage of their journey.

deliverables.name: Creative concepts
deliverables.text: We develop the core creative concepts that define and drive visual executions and communications.

deliverables.name: Brand identity
deliverables.text: We build brand identity systems that allow a brand to express itself across all channels and mediums.

deliverables.name: Tools and assets
deliverables.text: We create brand design principles and guidelines that allow you to own and execute your new identity.

deliverables.name: Training and maintenance
deliverables.text: We train internal teams in your new visual identity and help you maintain your brand as your organization grows.

name: Brand communication
summary: We find the right words to express new ideas, simplify complex topics, and empower our clients to communicate in the most effective and meaningful ways.
metaDescription: Brand communication from Narris International: narrative, messaging systems and executive communication strategy.
lead: We find the right words to express new ideas, simplify complex topics, and empower our clients to communicate in the most effective and meaningful ways.

deliverables.name: Messaging
deliverables.text: We establish and organize the underlying content—the core themes and facts—that brands should communicate to both external and internal audiences.

deliverables.name: Voice
deliverables.text: We create a brand's unique tone of voice, so they can stand out in the marketplace and make more immediate connections with their stakeholders.

deliverables.name: Strategic storytelling
deliverables.text: Whether it's in a manifesto or video, or on the About Us of a brand's website, we bring a brand's strategy to life in narrative form.

deliverables.name: Content strategy
deliverables.text: We help brands determine what to say, how to say it and where to say it across their experiences, including websites, apps and events.

deliverables.name: Content creation
deliverables.text: We provide ongoing as well as one-off content-creation and editorial services, helping brands deliver powerful communications to the world.

deliverables.name: Campaign development
deliverables.text: We transform brand ideas into dynamic, voice-driven campaigns across channels, for both internal and external audiences.

name: Brand-led change
summary: We help clients deliver on the full potential of their brand by embedding it in the hearts, minds and actions of the entire organization.
metaDescription: Brand-led change from Narris International: transition communication, stakeholder trust and executive counsel through institutional change.
lead: We help clients deliver on the full potential of their brand by embedding it in the hearts, minds and actions of the entire organization.

deliverables.name: Explain the why
deliverables.text: We help you explain, engage and excite people in the promise of your brand.

deliverables.name: Lead with culture
deliverables.text: We uncover the strengths of your culture and identify areas to build, leading to long-term success.

deliverables.name: Make purpose real
deliverables.text: We define and create brand-led experiences that equip your people to take action behind a strategic idea.

deliverables.name: Define your employer brand
deliverables.text: We work with you to define a compelling, differentiated EVP and employer experience that attracts and retains top talent.

deliverables.name: Keep it relevant
deliverables.text: We give you the tools to measure progress, identify opportunities and strengthen your brand.

perspective: Time may be changing but the promise you make to employees never should
